### Preliminaries
Let $S_n = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i$. The condition $N > n$ is equivalent to $S_n \le 1$.
Therefore, we can express the expected value of the non-negative integer random variable $N$ using the tail sum formula:
$$ E[N] = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} P(N > n) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} P(S_n \le 1) $$
Note that $S_0 = 0$, so $P(S_0 \le 1) = 1$.
